extraction.Name: James Huggins
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded August 10, 1920, by the Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Mortgage dated September 23, 1919, by James and Ora Huggins to Bank of Norden for $2400; this mortgage was released November 7, 1919 and a new mortgage by Huggins and his wife was made dated July 23, 1920 in favor of E. B. Bradley for $2000; this mortgage was assigned to Register Life Insurance Company of Davenport, Iowa and was due August 1, 1925
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: In 1927 prior taxes have been paid but at the time the records were viewed the 1928 taxes amounting to $96.15 had not been paid
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612717 issued; Southwest quarter section 16, township 95, north of range 78; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee but not dated; wife named Ora Huggins
